FIELDS.NAME: Elysian Jewelry & Watches
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Elegance St, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Elysian Jewelry & Watches, we specialize in retailing high-quality jewelry and timepieces, catering to a discerning clientele with a taste for elegance. Our operations focus solely on the sale of fine jewelry and watches, ensuring a curated selection that meets the highest standards of craftsmanship. We do not engage in any form of on-site manufacturing or pawn shop services, which helps us maintain a secure environment that prioritizes both quality and customer satisfaction. Our store is equipped with a 24/7 monitored alarm system to safeguard our valuable inventory, and we adhere strictly to comprehensive inventory management and loss prevention protocols. Staff members undergo thorough background checks to further enhance security and reduce the risk of internal theft. We pride ourselves on sourcing ethical gemstones and precious metals, underscoring our commitment to responsible business practices. With our dedication to providing exceptional products and services in a secure retail environment, we aim to foster a trustworthy relationship with our customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Elysian Fine Gifts, LLC - Specialty Home Décor
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a theft occurred at our store, resulting in a loss of $2,000 worth of jewelry. The incident was reported to the authorities, and security footage was reviewed. The claim status is currently under investigation by our insurance provider.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 4567 Gemstone Avenue, Suite 200, New York, NY 10001
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, Class 3, UL-listed for burglary protection.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24/7 monitored security personnel on-site during business hours to enhance loss prevention and safety measures.
